description: This file defines the AppPreferences class, a key-value storage wrapper around Android's SharedPreferences. It manages user preferences related to onboarding, city selection, calculation methods, Madhab school, latitude adjustment rules, notification settings, theme mode, and user account info in the Islamic Prayer Companion app.

classes.name: AppPreferences
classes.description: A class managing user preferences for the app, including onboarding, city settings, calculation options, theme, user modes, and notifications.

methods.name: isOnboardingComplete
methods.description: Returns whether onboarding has been completed.

methods.name: getSelectedCity
methods.description: Retrieves the user's selected city or defaults to Makkah.

methods.name: setSelectedCity
methods.description: Stores the user's selected city details.

methods.name: getHighLatitudeRule
methods.description: Retrieves the high latitude rule setting.

methods.name: notifyBeforeMinutes
methods.description: Gets the notification lead time in minutes.

methods.name: getUserMode
methods.description: Gets the current user mode (guest or Google).

methods.name: getGoogleAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the Google account ID if set.
